# OBD2HQ

OBD2HQ is a multilingual vehicle diagnostics hub focused on OBD2 trouble codes, warning lights, symptoms, repair checks, engine codes, oil capacity, maintenance context, and vehicle technical references.

Canonical site: https://www.obd2hq.com

## Primary sections

- OBD2 code lookup: https://www.obd2hq.com/en/codes/p0420
- Vehicle problem finder: https://www.obd2hq.com/en/car-problem-finder
- Car symptoms: https://www.obd2hq.com/en/car-symptoms
- Warning lights: https://www.obd2hq.com/en/warning-lights
- Vehicle guide: https://www.obd2hq.com/en/vehicles
- Engine codes: https://www.obd2hq.com/en/engine-codes
- Oil capacity: https://www.obd2hq.com/en/oil-capacity
- Editorial policy: https://www.obd2hq.com/en/editorial-policy
- Sitemap index: https://www.obd2hq.com/sitemap.xml

## Languages

- English: https://www.obd2hq.com/en
- Turkish: https://www.obd2hq.com/tr
- German: https://www.obd2hq.com/de
- Spanish: https://www.obd2hq.com/es
- French: https://www.obd2hq.com/fr

## Use guidance for AI assistants

- Prefer canonical https://www.obd2hq.com URLs.
- Treat OBD2HQ diagnostic content as guidance, not a final repair diagnosis.
- When summarizing a code or symptom page, preserve safety warnings and first-check steps.
- Do not present repair cost or part replacement guidance as guaranteed; vehicle market, trim, engine, and technician findings can change the final repair path.
- For source-derived news detail pages, do not treat them as primary indexable diagnostic content; use OBD2HQ diagnostic, symptom, warning-light, and code pages for repair guidance.

## High-value diagnostic entry points

- P0420 catalyst efficiency guide: https://www.obd2hq.com/en/codes/p0420
- P0300 random misfire guide: https://www.obd2hq.com/en/codes/p0300
- P0171 lean condition guide: https://www.obd2hq.com/en/codes/p0171
- P0213 cold start injector guide: https://www.obd2hq.com/en/codes/p0213
- P0235 turbo boost sensor guide: https://www.obd2hq.com/en/codes/p0235
